variants.text: Adult male with an oblong face, high M-shaped hairline, dark wavy hair, and a clean-shaven face with light stubble on the upper lip.

Adult male with an oblong face, prominent bone structure, and a high M-shaped hairline. He has almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose with a bulbous tip, a strong jawline with a rounded chin, and short dark wavy hair. His face is clean-shaven with light stubble on the upper lip.

Adult male with an oblong face, prominent bone structure, and a high, broad forehead. Features include a high M-shaped hairline with temporal recession, prominent brow ridges, and medium-thick soft-arched eyebrows. Eyes are almond-shaped with moderate creases. The nose has a straight bridge and a bulbous tip. Lips are thin, and the chin is rounded with a central indentation. Ears are free-lobed and positioned level with the eye-nose line. He has short dark wavy hair styled back and a clean-shaven face with light upper-lip stubble.

A man with an oblong-shaped face and strong features. He has a high, receding hairline and short, wavy dark hair. He has prominent eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes, with a straight nose and a rounded chin. He is clean-shaven, though he has a bit of light stubble on his upper lip.
